title: A disabled Input still repaints its border on hover
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists
details:
`components/Input.md:108` says a disabled Input suppresses hover effects.

`src/styles/components/input.css:162` sets `border-color: var(--muted)` on the wrapper's `:hover` with no disabled guard. That class sits on the wrapper `<div>` at `src/components/Input.tsx:72`, and the native `disabled` attribute on the inner control does not affect a wrapper.

Hovering a disabled field therefore still moves the border colour, so the disabled affordance is weaker than the specification promises.
